configurePresets.name: linux-base
configurePresets.description: Desktop Linux. Requires CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH pointing at a Qt 6.11.2 gcc_64 tree; supply it from CMakeUserPresets.json.

configurePresets.name: android-base
configurePresets.description: Android arm64. Requires the Qt android toolchain file, QT_HOST_PATH, and the SDK/NDK roots; supply them from CMakeUserPresets.json.

configurePresets.name: ci-linux
configurePresets.description: Used by .github/workflows/ci.yml. Reads QT_ROOT_DIR from the environment, which the workflow sets to the Qt install it just provisioned. Kept in the tracked file because CMakeUserPresets.json is gitignored, so a fresh clone has no invocable preset otherwise.
